name: Book Inventory
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton is frustrated by misplaced and missing tomes. He asks young adventurers to find Daniel, his daydreaming assistant, and take stock of the library archives, but Daniel's thoughts keep wandering to local tradeskills, making a straight answer hard to get.

sections.title: A Librarian's Frustration
sections.body: Northshire Abbey preserves old scholarly works, spiritual writings, and historical records that survived the First War in the Kingdom of Stormwind. Brother Paxton, a meticulous monk, takes great pride in the collection. Lately, books have gone missing from the shelves, and Paxton needs a clear inventory to learn how widespread the loss is. He has little patience to chase after his daydreaming helper.

sections.title: Daniel's Straying Interests
sections.body: Daniel works as Brother Paxton's assistant in the abbey library, but his thoughts rarely stay with parchment and catalog numbers. He is fascinated by the practical trades of Elwynn Forest: smithing, leatherworking, tailoring, and herbal craft. Paxton grows exasperated as inventory work leads Daniel to ramble about local crafters instead of locating lost scriptures.

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a monk of Northshire Abbey who tends its extensive collection of books, scriptures, and historical scrolls. He takes pride in the collection and is quick to lose his temper when books go missing or helpers shirk their duties.

Daniel is Brother Paxton's young assistant in the Northshire Abbey library. He is tasked with organizing books and conducting inventories, though his thoughts often turn to tradeskills and professions across Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why are books missing from Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton says books have gone missing but does not explain why. He asks Daniel to inventory the collection and determine how much has been lost.
Daniel is inside Northshire Abbey, among the shelves and desks of the abbey library.

faq.q: Why does Paxton call Daniel useless?
faq.answer: Paxton considers Daniel useless because he neglects his archival duties. Instead of cataloging and shelving books, Daniel spends his hours daydreaming and talking about practical tradeskills.

faq.q: What tradeskills is Daniel interested in?
faq.answer: Daniel is fascinated by crafts practiced throughout Elwynn Forest, such as blacksmithing, leatherworking, and tailoring. He prefers hands-on labor to dusty tomes.

angles.text: As a young human beginning service at Northshire Abbey, you may know the struggle to balance monastic study with practical village life.
As a priest studying Northshire's sacred archives, you rely on order in the library to preserve holy scriptures and Church traditions.
